title: Realistic Sculpted Audioengine Speaker Cake
caption: This fully sculpted cake is a hyper-realistic replica of an Audioengine bookshelf speaker, complete with branded logo, tweeter, and textured woofer cone. A strong pick for corporate events or audiophile birthdays. Custom sculpted cakes available across the Bay Area and San Francisco.
alt_text: Black sculpted fondant cake shaped like an Audioengine bookshelf speaker with tweeter, woofer, and branded logo on front panel.

title: Kawaii Steamed Bao Sculpted Cake
caption: This fully sculpted bao cake is covered in smooth fondant with hand-formed pleated folds and an applied kawaii face. A strong choice for themed birthdays or baby showers. My Baking Creations takes custom sculpted cake orders across the Bay Area and San Francisco.
alt_text: Sculpted fondant cake shaped like a kawaii steamed bao with brown eyes, pink cheeks, a smile, and pleated top folds.

title: Custom Sculpted 3D Dragon Birthday Cake
caption: Bennett's 4th birthday called for a fully sculpted red dragon cake — textured scales, black claws, horns, and wings, all hand-formed from fondant. My Baking Creations handles custom sculpted kids' birthday cakes across San Francisco and the Bay Area.
alt_text: 3D sculpted red dragon cake with black horns, claws, and wings. Chest reads "4 Bennett." Displayed on a gray scale-textured board.

title: Branded Corporate Logo Cookies for Events
caption: Custom printed Cvent logo cookies — sharp, consistent branding on a clean white royal icing base. Built for conferences, trade shows, and corporate gifting. My Baking Creations fulfills custom branded cookie orders throughout San Francisco and the Bay Area.
alt_text: Three white rectangular cookies with green Cvent logo printed on royal icing, arranged diagonally on a white background.
